Tree data loaded and top-level sections rendered

steps.name: tree_check
steps.script: function textsOf(sel){return Array.from(document.querySelectorAll(sel)).map(function(e){return e.textContent.trim();});} function topLi(name){return Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('#tree > li')).find(function(li){var k=li.querySelector(':scope > .row > .key'); return k && k.textContent.trim()===name;});} function directFolderKeys(li){return li?Array.from(li.querySelectorAll(':scope > ul.children > li > .row.folder > .key')).map(function(e){return e.textContent.trim();}):[];} var folderKeys=textsOf('.row.folder > .key'); var leafKeys=textsOf('.row.leaf > .key'); var leafVals=textsOf('.row.leaf > .val'); var bracket=/^\[\d+\]:?$/; var bracketFolders=folderKeys.filter(function(k){return bracket.test(k);}); var bracketLeaves=leafKeys.filter(function(k){return bracket.test(k);}); var topSections=textsOf('#tree > li > .row > .key'); var objectsLi=topLi('Objects'); var objectBuckets=directFolderKeys(objectsLi); var procLi=objectsLi?Array.from(objectsLi.querySelectorAll(':scope > ul.children > li')).find(function(li){var k=li.querySelector(':scope > .row > .key'); return k && k.textContent.trim()==='Procedures';}):null; var procKeys=directFolderKeys(procLi).concat(Array.from(procLi?procLi.querySelectorAll(':scope > ul.children > li > .row.leaf > .key'):[]).map(function(e){return e.textContent.trim();})); var trustedProcLi=procLi?Array.from(procLi.querySelectorAll(':scope > ul.children > li')).find(function(li){var k=li.querySelector(':scope > .row > .key'); return k && k.textContent.trim()==='Trusted procedure source';}):null; var trustedProcFiles=directFolderKeys(trustedProcLi); var seedsLi=topLi('Tests'); var seedsFolder=seedsLi?Array.from(seedsLi.querySelectorAll(':scope ul.children li > .row.folder > .key')).map(function(e){return e.textContent.trim();}).filter(function(k){return k.indexOf('warehouse')>=0||k.indexOf('entidade')>=0||k.indexOf('armazem')>=0||k.indexOf('area')>=0;}):[]; var grantsLeaf=leafVals.filter(function(v){return v==='EXECUTE_FLOW'||v==='READ_EXECUTIONS'||v==='READ_FLOW_DEFINITIONS';}); return JSON.stringify({totalFolders:folderKeys.length,totalLeaves:leafKeys.length,bracketFolders:bracketFolders,bracketLeaves:bracketLeaves,topSections:topSections,objectBuckets:objectBuckets,procedureKeys:procKeys,trustedProcedureFiles:trustedProcFiles,seedsRelatedLabels:seedsFolder.slice(0,15),grantsFoundAsPlainValues:grantsLeaf});
